text:
denise: pushed a new commit addressing the comments on PR #4321 — adjusted retry/backoff and added unit tests. PTAL when you get a sec. @sam @alex

sam: thanks — will try to run tests locally in a few mins. quick Q: did you change the default shard timeout as we discussed? iirc there was an open edge case.

denise: yep, bumped default from 30s -> 45s and left a TODO to revisit cadence. small diff snippet in the PR: 
```
const DefaultShardTimeout = 45 * time.Second // was 30s, see PR#4321
```

alex: LGTM from me after running unit tests locally. left one tiny nit about the logging key (non-blocking).

denise: addressed the logging nit and force-pushed. smoke locally: `mage smoke` ✅

merge-bot: CI finished — all checks passed ✅. (auto-checker: lint, unit, integration)

sam: i can give a manual approve in ~30m. denise — do you want me to hold merge until the 10:00am PST canary window?

denise: yes please hold for the 10:00am PST canary window. i'll add the canary label and update the rollout notes.

sam: ack — adding :canary: label now.

denise: thanks! ping me if anything else comes up before the window.
